name: successor-rejects-spec-paths
title: active-task-review-successor rejects the spec updates finish-work itself requires
description: The active-task-review-successor recovery forbids every path under .trellis/ except the task's own directory and journal/index files, so it rejects the .trellis/spec/ changes that the finish-work flow's mandatory spec-update step produces. Reported from platypeeps/sd-github-review PR #72 at pack 0.64.3, where no final-bundle mode could validate the branch and the PR merged outside the housekeeping gate.
creator: sdelmas
